vulnerabilities.description: API key is hardcoded in source code, making it accessible to anyone with access to the codebase
vulnerabilities.impact: Unauthorized access to external services, potential data breach
vulnerabilities.fix_applied: API key moved to environment variable with proper validation

vulnerabilities.code_snippet: sql = "SELECT id, username FROM users WHERE username LIKE '%{}%'".format(name)
vulnerabilities.description: User input directly formatted into SQL query without sanitization
vulnerabilities.impact: Complete database compromise, data extraction, modification, or deletion
vulnerabilities.fix_applied: Implemented parameterized queries with input validation
vulnerabilities.secure_implementation: sql = "SELECT id, username FROM users WHERE username LIKE ?"; cur.execute(sql, (f'%{name}%',))

vulnerabilities.description: Pickle deserialization of untrusted data allows remote code execution
vulnerabilities.impact: Complete system compromise, arbitrary code execution
vulnerabilities.fix_applied: Replaced pickle with JSON for safe deserialization with validation

vulnerabilities.description: User input directly concatenated into shell command
vulnerabilities.impact: Arbitrary command execution on the server
vulnerabilities.fix_applied: Implemented command allowlist and safe subprocess execution
vulnerabilities.secure_implementation: subprocess.run() with shell=False and command validation

vulnerabilities.description: Plaintext password storage and weak password policy

vulnerabilities.description: Debug mode enabled in production reveals sensitive information

fix_details.fix_summary: Moved hardcoded API key to environment variables and validated at runtime
fix_details.rationale: Storing secrets in environment variables avoids leaking keys in code repositories and allows rotation
fix_details.notes: Developers must set the API_KEY environment variable before starting the app

fix_details.fix_summary: Rewrote SQL operations to use parameterized queries and validated input
fix_details.rationale: Parameterized queries prevent SQL injection by separating data from query structure
fix_details.notes: Keep queries parameterized and validate inputs for length and characters

fix_details.fix_summary: Replaced insecure pickle deserialization with JSON parsing and strict validation
fix_details.rationale: JSON deserialization does not execute arbitrary code unlike pickle
fix_details.notes: Avoid any unsafe deserialization unless using strict allow-lists and safe libraries

fix_details.fix_summary: Replaced shell command execution with a safe, mapped allowlist implemented in Python
fix_details.rationale: Executing shell commands is error-prone and platform dependent; restricting to safe builtins prevents injection
fix_details.notes: If external commands are necessary, run them with full paths and sanitization; prefer native handlers

fix_details.fix_summary: Escaped template variables and used Jinja's 'e' filter to prevent template injection
fix_details.rationale: Escaping user-controlled data prevents XSS and template evaluation
fix_details.notes: Continue to validate and escape any user-provided content rendered in templates

fix_details.fix_summary: Stored hashed passwords with salt and implemented a stronger verification flow
fix_details.rationale: Plaintext passwords are a severe risk; salted hashes mitigate password theft consequences
fix_details.notes: For production, use dedicated authentication services and strong hashing (bcrypt/Argon2)

fix_details.fix_summary: Disabled debug mode in production and toggled by environment variable
fix_details.rationale: Debug mode exposes sensitive information and should not be enabled in production
fix_details.notes: Use secure logging and set FLASK_ENV to 'development' only in safe environments
